historic_survey.finding: Not eligible for the National Register, the California Register or City Landmark designation
historic_survey.year_built_as_surveyed: Not identified; late 1910s or early 1920s by appearance
historic_survey.note: One of eight parcels the evaluation surveyed intensively, and one of five buildings the proposed Diamond/Bosworth infill site would demolish. Surveyed with 25 Brompton Avenue as one property on Lot 030, which has since been split; this is the smaller building, standing behind the one on the street, with a rear shed-roofed addition. No original building permit was found and it is not on the 1913–1915 Sanborn map, so the evaluation dates it only by appearance; the assessor dates it to 1915.
